## Checklist

- [ ] `node scripts/validate.mjs` passes.
- [ ] If `AGENTS.md` changed, I ran `node scripts/build.mjs` and committed the generated files.
- [ ] Every platform command or configuration key I added is checked against current official documentation, and `docs/compatibility.md` is updated.
- [ ] A new skill solves a problem no existing skill covers, and its description says when to use it.
- [ ] User-visible changes are listed in `CHANGELOG.md` under an unreleased heading.
